gloss: to tempt; to seduce; to lure

definitions.gloss: to tempt; to lure; to entice
definitions.explanation: To attract or entice someone toward something, often something they should resist. The temptation may involve food, money, pleasure, or other desires.
To attract someone romantically or sexually, often with the implication of leading them away from proper behavior.

notes:
A compound of {誘|ゆう} (to invite; to lead) and {惑|わく} (to be confused; to go astray). The noun form ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧ is also very common, used in phrases like ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}ける→誘惑に負ける：25828_yuuwakunimakeru⟧ (to give in to temptation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}に{負|ま}ける→誘惑に負ける：25828_yuuwakunimakeru⟧: to give in to temptation
- ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧: to resist temptation
- ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抗|あらが}う→抗う：09141_aragau⟧: to fight against temptation
- ⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}られる→駆る：14715_karu⟧: to be driven by temptation
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{誘惑|ゆうわく}→誘惑：14209_yuuwaku⟧: sweet temptation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誘|さそ}う→誘う：01947_sasou⟧: to invite; to lure — more neutral; covers friendly invitations as well as enticement
- ⟦{惑|まど}わす→惑わす：28047_madowasu⟧: to lead astray; to bewitch — emphasizes confusion and deception
- ⟦{口説|くど}く→口説く：11852_kudoku⟧: to woo; to come on to — specifically romantic/sexual persuasion, more direct
